title: Yields Hit Multiyear Highs on Oil Surge, Fed Hike Bets
description:
"Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Sydney with Shery Ahn and Haidi Stroud-Watts, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - Bloomberg: The Asia Trade begins
00:01:03 - Markets weigh higher yields, surging oil
00:11:11 - ANZ's Mahjabeen Zaman on FX strategy
00:18:09 - Oracle, Microsoft bet big on data centers
00:23:37 - Brent spikes as Middle East tensions persist
00:30:20 - Trump promises $500 refunds for Obamacare plans
00:33:58 - Expanded BRICS bloc to meet in India this weekend
00:38:33 - DeepSeek unveils ultra-low-cost AI model
00:41:29 - South Korea ramps up spy law to protect chip secrets
00:44:05 - BREAKING: Japan Aug. producer prices rise 7.6% Y/Y; est. +7.4%
00:46:45 - Markets open in Japan, South Korea and Australia
00:50:29 - Ascalon Capital CIO Isaac Poole on markets strategy
01:01:12 - Vance seeks to stake claim as Trump scion at GOP gala
01:05:20 - EXCLUSIVE: State Bank of India's MD Ashwini Kumar Tewari on growth outlook
01:13:41 - BlackRock's Gargi Chaudhuri on US markets strategy
01:22:38 - DeepSeek low-cost model deals fresh blow to rivals
01:25:45 - BREAKING: OpenAI is open to slowing cutting-edge AI, Altman tells staff
01:26:38 - SoftBank rally raises short squeeze risk
